printf '# a comment

export OPENROUTER_MODEL_SOL="openai/gpt-5.6-sol"
OPENROUTER_API_KEY=k
' > .env; D="$PWD/req.json"; printf '%s' '{"objective":"x"}' | SOL_REQUEST_DUMP="$D" MOCK_RESPONSE_FILE="$FIXTURES/sol-transport/openrouter-with-cost.json" bash "$PLUGIN_ROOT/scripts/call_sol.sh" --mode adversary --via openrouter >/dev/null 2>&1; jq -r .model "$D"
